+## Summary
+
+Increase the cache TTL for pricing data from 15 minutes to 1 hour, and remove the unused fallback lookup function.
+
+## Changes
+
+- Bumped `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 (15 minutes) to 3600 (1 hour) to reduce feed refresh overhead while maintaining reasonable freshness.
+- Removed the `lookup()` fallback function which was unused and no longer needed.
+
+## Testing
+
+Verify that pricing data is still fresh enough for use cases and that removing the lookup function does not impact any dependent code.
